May He be favorable to you and to all your benefactors - most especially those in Beech Grove Hospital and bring them more and more to realize and to appreciate the privilege of harboring a religious "so tempted and tried in the humilia- tions of extraneous "warfare in the world.

regions.merged_text: July 21st. Dear Mother Hilda. God help us! You see I did not get far a week ago. I do hope you keep up courage and persevere these trying times, - glorious times if by God's grace we persvere in "keeping the faith: and, God willing, having the privilege of finally giving our life its defense. For surely "civilization" has been rapidly losing its one- time rational balance. Thank God however, there are still members of society - of the human-race - who like the seers of old and the prophets and apostles keep faith with God our divine Creator and Preserver; but, Alas! for modern society! civilization! humanity! If ever the words of Isias, have been applicable to a people or a generation of nations, they are surely appropriate today in reference to the majority of our modern "scientests", "educators", "statesmen", "Governments": "With desolation is all the world made desolate, because there is none that thinketh in their hearts."

regions.merged_text: "Scientests" that refuse to recognize as a science, the most privi- leged and most fortunate relationship and dependence of the rational creacheron the divine Creator and Preserver of the Universe! "Scientests" and "educators", etc, that fail to see or refuse to recognize "general principals the truth of which can be plainly perceived by the light of reason"; as Pope Leo XIII, in his Encyclical on the Holy Eucharist de- clares, - giving - "for instance", the most important, all-outstanding principal whereon rests to humanity the sanctity and the soul of the Ten Commandments of God and the authority of all legitimate, divine authority; - "for instance, that the dominion of God our Creator and Preserver over all men, whether in their private or in their public life, is supreme and absolute; that our whole being and all that we possess, whether individually or as members of society, comes from the divine bounty; that we on our part are bound to show to God, as our Lord, the highest reverence, and, as He is our greatest benefactor, the deepest gratitude."
